Subject: Full-loop candidate: Priya Reddy — multi-slot options & panel sequencing

Hi team,

We have Priya Reddy (applied for Backend Engineer, strong systems background) progressing to a full virtual onsite. Hiring committee asked for a compact, predictable slate to minimize context switching for the candidate (APAC overlap). Proposed windows are for Tues 16 Jan (PST) with two possible start times — ANCHOR A (09:30 PST) or ANCHOR B (13:00 PST).

Key asks:
- Can each interviewer confirm which anchor you prefer? If neither works, give 2 available windows next week.
- We want the sequence to prioritize system design early while Priya is freshest, keep pairing-style deep dive later.

Suggested sequencing (compact, with small buffers):
1) Hiring manager intro / role fit — 30m (Jonas)
2) System design — 50m (Laura)
3) Deep dive: performance/scale case study — 45m (Marissa)
4) Team fit / collaboration — 30m (Kimberly)
5) 20m wrap + debrief buffer (all)

Attachments: candidate resume + virtual onsite runbook + debrief scorecard.

Notes on logistics: 10 minute breaks between long slots; we'll provide a soft fallback to a shorter variant if candidate needs morning cut. Please reply with your preferred anchor and any constraints by end of day.

Thanks,
Avery
